provenance.source: Git archive of the accepted WP15 review commit. Only its capture test harness was extended. The WP15 renderer, scene and assets came from the archive.
provenance.command: THRUM_WATER_PROOF=under-light-cost THRUM_WATER_DIVE=trade THRUM_REQUIRE_GPU=1 cargo test --release --locked --offline -p water-scene --test proof_gpu
provenance.view: WP15 ordinary dive scene with craft where present. 105 degree vertical field, east-facing, 60 degree Sun. Lake and sea at 3 m below mean water, beach 2 m above and pitched 73 degrees down.
provenance.warmup: Wait for cooked scene. Render 16 frames from elapsed 1.0 s at 1/120 s spacing and retain the last 12.
provenance.target: Apple M3 Max Metal, macOS 26.6.2 (25G83), rustc 1.100.0
